candidates.mechanism: The Streamable HTTP server treats Accept entries as exact media types, rejecting */*, type wildcards, and quality-parameter forms commonly sent by generic HTTP clients.
candidates.target_behavior: Accept matching recognizes */*, application/*, text/*, and q-parameter forms only where they cover the required JSON/SSE response types, while missing or incompatible types still return 406.
verification_method: Checkout the frozen base SHA and apply the upstream wildcard/missing/incompatible Accept regression matrix.
Confirm the valid wildcard cases fail on the base while negative controls remain rejected.
Apply the minimal parser/matcher repair and confirm the full matrix becomes green.
Run adjacent Streamable HTTP request-validation tests and archive the red/green evidence.
